tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns the GoNoGo account connected to ChatGPT.

tools.name: interview_with_alex
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find out whether their own startup, app or business idea is worth building: whether there is a market, who has the problem and would pay for it, whether to quit a job or spend months on it, or to rehearse the questions an accelerator or investor will ask about the ide

tools.name: list_my_projects
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about their GoNoGo projects: which ideas they have tested, their GO / NO-GO verdicts, or whether the research is still running. Do not use to start a new interview.

tools.name: get_project_result
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the verdict, score or research status of one of their GoNoGo projects, for example after finishing an interview with Alex. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "interview_with_alex" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Opens a live voice interview with Alex, GoNoGo's AI startup mentor (a talking video avatar). Alex asks the hard questions about the founder's startup or business idea (who has the problem, what they do today, who pays, why now) and records the answers; GoNoGo then researches the market and gives a G" → after: "Use this when the user wants to find out whether their own startup, app or business idea is worth building: whether there is a market, who has the problem and would pay for it, whether to quit a job or spend months on it, or to rehearse the questions an accelerator or investor will ask about the ide"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
